title: Retire live `exhausted` disposition references
goal: Replace every non-historical use of `exhausted` as a disposition word in comments, prose, and docs with the current vocabulary (`out_of_turns` / `timed_out`) introduced by #2187; add dated backward-pointer notes where ADR text must stay for historical accuracy.

steps.description: Fix the comment table in `dispatch_rc_legacy_disposition`. Line 166 still says `10 scope_too_large → exhausted "more budget, or the work must shrink"` while the function body (line 181) already emits `out_of_turns`. Update the comment row to show `out_of_turns` (ADR-054 §6a, #2187) and remove or correct the pre-#2187 response quoted in the prose.

Fix the stale comment in `review-lens` plugin above the rc=10 branch. Line 379 says 'Write disposition:exhausted and propagate rc=10' but the code on line 382 already writes `out_of_turns`. Update the comment to say `out_of_turns`; leave the `budget_exhausted` reason/detail argument on line 382 unchanged (it is not a disposition word and is not flagged by the lint rule).

Update wiki prose in `review-report.md`. Line 137 says 'disposition is `complete`, or `exhausted` when a lens call returned non-zero'. Replace `exhausted` with `out_of_turns` to match what the stage actually writes since #2187.

Update keepers-manifest issue body. Line 1430 says '`disposition: exhausted` escalates (ADR-054 §6)'. Replace `exhausted` with `out_of_turns` and update the ADR reference to §6a so the closed issue body no longer describes the retired vocabulary as current.

Add a dated backward-pointer to ADR-054 §4 rc table row for rc=10. The row at line 163 reads '`10` scope_too_large | `exhausted` (§6)'. The issue directs adding a dated pointer to §6a (`out_of_turns`) — the original text stays for historical chain-of-custody; the note makes it clear the word is superseded without deleting the migration record.

Add a dated backward-pointer to ADR-001 §recovery retirement note. Line 163 reads '`escalate` → `exhausted`'. The surrounding text is the 2026-08-20 #1900 retirement note (explicitly historical). Add a short inline note — e.g. '(`exhausted` retired #2187; now `out_of_turns`)' — so the reader is not misled by the old vocabulary without removing the historical record.

notes: Part 1 of this issue (budget-block helpers for impact, security-lens, spec-coverage, issue-acceptance) is fully done in #2253 (merged), including the tests in tests/unit/stage-budget-note-test.sh. Only Part 2 — retiring `exhausted` — remains. plugins/agent/review-report/plugin.sh was listed in the issue but grep finds no `exhausted` there; it was already cleaned up in a prior merge and requires no change. After all six steps the only grep hits for `exhausted` in the acceptance-check scope will be: (a) ADR-054 §6 table row ~line 223 (explicitly superseded by §6a per the amendment header), (b) ADR-054 §6a prose at ~lines 239 and 258 which explicitly describe `exhausted` as retired history, (c) ADR-001 line 163 which is inside the 2026-08-20 #1900 historical retirement note (with the new dated pointer added in step-6), and (d) review-lens `budget_exhausted` on line 382 which is a reason/detail argument, not a disposition word, and is not in scope of the lint rule. No new tests are required: all behavioral code already uses `out_of_turns`; the changes are prose/comment only; `npm run lint` (which runs lint-disposition-words.sh) does not inspect comment text. Build Mode is ADR-057 gate 4 (prompt text and comments/docs only).
